title: London-based 9fin, which offers AI tools to help credit traders and investors originate new business efficiently, raised a $170M Series C at a $1.3B valuation (Ryan Gould/Bloomberg)
summary: Ryan Gould / Bloomberg: London-based 9fin, which offers AI tools to help credit traders and investors originate new business efficiently, raised a $170M Series C at a $1.3B valuation — 9fin Ltd., the debt intelligence provider founded by two former investment banking analysts, has raised fresh funds …
